title: This app will randomly delete your notes
body: This app randomly deleted notes I had been working on for days, and there's no way to recover them. I’ve read that others have experienced the same issue, even a couple of years ago, and it’s shocking to me that Apple still hasn’t fixed this problem. Not only is the app difficult to use and extremely hard to figure out, but it also constantly glitches and keeps crashing. It’s incredibly disappointing. I just wish I had known this before, so I hope this helps someone: unless you’re willing to risk losing hours of your work, DO NOT USE THIS APP.

title: Cursor Positioning Issue in Tables within Apple Notes
body: I am experiencing a recurring issue within the Apple Notes application when interacting with tables. Whenever I type text into a table cell, the cursor automatically jumps backwards, disrupting the flow of typing and forcing me to correct the entry multiple times. This issue significantly affects the usability of the tables feature within the app. Please address this bug to restore the expected functionality of text entry within tables in Apple Notes.

title: All my notes disappeared
body: After 3-4 years of using this app (and storing important information in there), everything just disappeared. There's no "recently deleted" folder either, because I didn't delete anything on my own. More than 30 notes just gone in a second and I can't recover them (because they're nowhere to be found). If app developers have a solution, I'd appreciate to be contacted. And no, they're not on iCloud either, because I just stored them using my telephone's storage, without syncing to cloud.

title: If you hate your notes and want them deleted once a day, please use this app
body: Apple, this is just embarassing! The app's undo option (aka shake the tablet like an idiot) sometimes works, sometimes doesn't (especialy great when the intention to undo should cover the apps bug where it eats half of the links when copy-pasting from one note to another). The sync between iPhone an iPad erases parts of the notes, whole notes dissapear without recovery option etc.. This is just the most unreliable carelessly made idiotic app I have ever seen! Apple, shame on you! Like you just don't care. And thank you for eating 70% of my REALY important notes, without any option of recovery. Shame on you again! Bad bad, lazy Apple...
